champion.builds: THE BEST CHO'GATH BUILDS, RUNES AND ITEMS FOR SUPPORT IN EMERALD + Most Popular If you want to use the most popular Cho'Gath Support build, you should take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. For runes, you should pick Hail of Blades as your keystone, followed by Cheap Shot, Deep Ward and Relentless Hunter in the primary tree, as well as Axiom Arcanist and Celerity in the secondary tree. For rune shards, you want Adaptive Force in offense, Move Speed in flex and Health Scaling in defense, though it depends on the matchup. Finally, for your items, you should build Celestial Opposition as your first item, followed by Symbiotic Soles and Shurelya's Battlesong. For your last 3 items, you should build Trailblazer, Force of Nature and finish with Vigilant Wardstone. For the skill order, you want to stick with E - W - Q. Right now, this build has 51.0% winrate over 96 matches played. Optional Your second option for Cho'Gath Support build would be to take Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells. The runes that this build takes advantage of are Arcane Comet as your keystone, Manaflow Band, Transcendence and Scorch in the primary tree, and Biscuit Delivery with Cosmic Insight in the secondary tree. The shards used in this build are Adaptive Force in offense, Adaptive Force in flex and Health in defense. The items for the build are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike, which you should build first, followed by Sorcerer's Shoes as your second item and Hextech Rocketbelt as your third item. The rest of the items in order are Zhonya's Hourglass, Unending Despair and Redemption. The skill order for this build is Q - W - E. In the current patch, this build has a 42.4% win rate over 59 matches. Alternative If you're looking for alternatives, you can use Flash and Ignite as your Summoner Spells, with runes being Hail of Blades as your keystone, Cheap Shot, Grisly Mementos and Ultimate Hunter in the primary tree, and Axiom Arcanist with Celerity in the secondary tree, as well as Adaptive Force, Move Speed, and Health Scaling as your rune shards. The items that this build incorporates are Zaz'Zak's Realmspike as your first item, then Boots of Swiftness as a second item and Hextech Rocketbelt as a third item. You want to finish the build with Riftmaker, Thornmail and Kaenic Rookern. As far as ability max order goes, you want to keep it E - Q - W. This build is currently sitting at a 43.1% win rate across 51 matches played. Situational Cho'Gath Runes and Items Depending on the context of your game, your matchup, and enemy champions, you might want to consider building some situational items or take specific runes. Carefully examine your team, enemy team, game state , and your matchup to plan your Cho'Gath build accordingly! For example, when it comes to rune shards, you might want to take either Armor or Magic Resist, depending on which champion you are about to lane against. Furthermore, if you want a more detailed breakdown, you should also check out Cho'Gath runes page.
